## want to make multi cowplots to summarize the removal of temporal outliers
for each segment, read in the already saved png files in the given folder name matching the string
then, use cowplot and ggdraw maybe to arrange plot images in a 2 by 2 grid, and export by segment

```{r}
library(cowplot)
library(magick)
library(fs)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

# inputs
img_dir <-"../2026-01-14_rem-outliers/figs"
out_dir <-"cowplots"
segments<-c("PB2","PB1","PA","HA","NP","NA","M","NS")  
dir_create(out_dir)

# helper: read PNG -> ggplot object 
png_to_gg<-function(png_path, crop_top_frac = 0.10) {
  img<-magick::image_read(png_path)
  info<-magick::image_info(img)
  w<-info$width[1]
  h<-info$height[1]

  # crop off top X% by shifting down and reducing height to remove segment name ggtitle
  crop_px<-round(h * crop_top_frac)
  new_h  <-max(1, h - crop_px)

  # geometry: "<width>x<height>+<x_offset>+<y_offset>"
  geom<-paste0(w, "x", new_h, "+0+", crop_px)
  img2<-magick::image_crop(img, geom)

  ggdraw() +
    draw_image(img2, x = 0, y = 0, width = 1, height = 1) +
    theme_void()
}

# define the 4 filenames per segment
expected_files<-function(seg) {
  c(paste0("TemporalSignalResidInclOutlier_", seg, ".png"),
    paste0("TemporalSignalResidExclOutliers_",seg, ".png"),
    paste0("densityResiduals_N-outliers_",    seg, ".png"),
    paste0("PendantEdges_N-outliers_",        seg, ".png")) }

# 2x2 grid per segment
save_segment_grid<-function(seg, img_dir, out_dir, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300) {
  wanted<-expected_files(seg)
  paths <-path(img_dir, wanted)

  # check missing
  missing<-wanted[!file_exists(paths)]
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    message("Skipping ", seg, " (missing): ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
    return(NA_character_) }
  plots<-map(paths, png_to_gg)

  # 2x2 grid; add labels A-D if you want by uncommenting labels=...
  grid<-plot_grid(plotlist = plots, ncol = 2, nrow = 2, align = "hv",
    labels = c("A) Fit incl. outliers","B) Fit excl. outliers",
               "C) Residuals outliers","D) Pendant edge outliers"),
    label_size = 16,  label_x = -0.05)

  # optional title
  titled<-ggdraw() +
    draw_label(paste0(seg, " temporal outlier removal"), 
               x = 0.5, y = 0.98, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, 
               fontface = "bold", size = 18) +
    draw_plot(grid, x = 0, y = 0, width = 1, height = 0.95)

  out_file<-path(out_dir, paste0("TemporalOutlierSummary_", seg, ".png"))
  ggsave(out_file, titled, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white")

  out_file
}

written<-map_chr(segments, save_segment_grid, img_dir = img_dir, out_dir = out_dir)
written<-written[!is.na(written)]
message("Wrote ", length(written), " grids:\n", paste(" - ", written, collapse = "\n"))
```
